newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, blue chips gain.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed on Wednesday with gains among the blue chips and losses among the hoteliers.
* Of 14 active issues, nine rose, four were down and one remained flat.
* Volume higher at 16,958, turnover lower at 10.6 million kuna. Exchange rate: 5.4684 kuna = $1.
* Biggest gainer Zagrebacka Banka E series shares rose 40 kuna to close at 400 on volume of 369.
* Biggest loser Istrian hotelier Jadranturist, down 52 kuna to close at 360 on small volume of 92 shares.
* Most actively traded was food processor Podravka, gaining five kuna to close at 285, trading 6,146 shares.
